author: Inside Edition
description: We're learning more about the shocking plane crash in Palm Beach, Florida. A private jet lost control and nosedived into a neighborhood, killing all nine people aboard. The crash was caught on camera, and the haunting final words of its crew have been circulating on social media. Investigators are trying to determine if weather played a role. As Inside Edition's Steven Fabian reports, many were surprised to hear that the pilot had complained about ice.
title: What Caused A Devastating Private Jet Crash in Palm Beach?

author: Inside Edition
description: Control of both houses in Congress are on the line in the midterm elections. A record $12 billion has been spent on ads and a record 53 million people voted early. Even the Pope voted early by mail-in ballot. Meanwhile, in Michigan, Haley Stevens, the runner-up in the Democrat primary, turned on her party and its candidate, Abdul El-Sayed, and endorsed the Republican Senate candidate Mike Rogers. Party leaders are calling her decision a betrayal. President Donald Trump is celebrating the upheaval.
title: Record Number Of Early Votes Cast In Critical Midterm Election

author: Inside Edition
description: The Kennedy Center is closed for renovations as a legal battle rages with President Donald Trump fighting to put his name on the performing arts center. It was confirmed Monday the show will go on as this year's Kennedy Center honorees were announced. However, for the first time in 50 years, the honors will be held at the Capital One Arena in downtown Washington D.C.. Honorees include singer Paul Anka, music producer David Foster and actor Andy Garcia.
title: Kennedy Center Honors To Be Held At Different Venue

author: Inside Edition
description: Millions of schoolchildren donned Halloween costumes this year, but they weren't the only ones to dress up; plenty of celebrities also got into the Halloween holiday spirit. Martha Stewart raised eyebrows for dressing as a homeless person. The lifestyle guru said she was trying to raise awareness of homelessness, but admitted she "really screwed up" with her costume choice.
title: Martha Stewart Apologizes For Halloween Costume

author: Inside Edition
description: Savannah Guthrie's daughter drew a touching image of an umbrella surrounded by raindrops and a moving message, "I know it might not seem like it but I really need my mommy." Guthrie posted the drawing in a new appeal for information about her missing mother, Nancy. It has been more than nine months since she vanished, and Tucson investigators appear stymied. The last contact from the purported kidnappers said Nancy Guthrie died shortly after being abducted, but her body has not been found.
title: Savannah Guthrie Posts Touching Image Drawn By Her Daughter

author: Inside Edition
description: Nearly a year after a Los Angeles woman disappeared, authorities say two people have been arrested in connection with her killing. The LAPD announced Delorean Brandon, 41, and Kaylee Markowski, 34, were arrested for the death of Christina Downer, 38. CBS News reports Brandon is allegedly an ex-boyfriend of Downer. Investigators say Downer was reported missing in December 2025 by her ex-husband, who requested a welfare check. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: LAPD Arrests 2 Suspects in Killing of Christina Downer, Sister of 'SNL' Writer

author: Inside Edition
description: Toshisuke Kanazawa, 90, recently traveled from Japan to Santa Susanna in Spain to compete in the age 50-and-over category of a bodybuilding competition. He credits his health and longevity to a traditional Japanese diet. He says age is not a barrier to strenuous exercise and competition. While he did not make it to the awards podium, he said he was still proud of being a fit senior citizen and hopes to inspire others to be the same.
title: 90-Year-Old Japanese Man Competes In Bodybuilding Competition

author: Inside Edition
description: Workers with Bear Valley Electric Service had an unusual service call when they were asked to rescue a great horned owl. The bird was trapped between two wires and hanging upside down. After shutting off the power, the seasoned crew immediately got to work. Using equipment from their truck, they freed the calm bird, and then the local zoo made sure it wasn't injured. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Utility Workers Rescue Great Horned Owl Trapped By Power Lines

author: Inside Edition
description: A Tennessee family was robbed right in front of their home in broad daylight by a brazen gang of thieves. Black bears broke into a pickup truck and helped themselves to the groceries inside. Pam Conley says she started recording and was initially amused when one of the bears grabbed some of the family's snacks. But she became concerned when the bears broke a bottle of beer. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Black Bears Steal Groceries From Family's Vehicle Outside Their Home

author: Inside Edition
description: The Forest Green Rovers, who play in Britain's National League, have placed than 60 plants in their locker room, hoping for a calming mood. The greenery is meant to help players manage stress and improve their mental well-being. The thinking is a more relaxed team makes for a stronger team on the field. The plant makeover coincides with International Stress Awareness Week.
title: Why Are There Dozens of Plants In The Locker Room of A Soccer Team?

author: Inside Edition
description: Julio Rivera's death in Queens, New York led to major changes in the way some crimes were investigated and prosecuted.
title: How One Man's Brutal Killing Led To First Hate Crimes Arrests #shorts
